title: Crystal Components
body:
# This mod plans to add Many Crystal based Redstone components.

## Amethyst button

![Amethyst button In action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c9a540289b9c8d46a7426ad64d2e3616a596249.gif)

**The Amethyst button Pulses multiple different signal strengths while active
The sequence is as follows: [8,0,4,0,8,0,4,0] With a 2 tick interval (1 Redstone tick)**



## Decorative Redstone components

### All Buttons and the Lever have a cosmetic version that doesn't output any redstone signal, and can be powered by redstone to animate

Crafted by combining the normal counter-part with any flower

![All the Decorative Redstone triggering](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba521d1b63f7247c5df25870816ca6e4dbf0a623.gif) 

![The components don't emit redstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed63f4668bde6815898583587db04134349da5a1.gif)

![The lever remembers which way you set it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ca87e44bc2639411d84bac9fc0dcd6ac89421bf.gif)
